name: secure-asset-exchange-platform
description: Production-oriented Secure Digital Asset Exchange Platform

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.audit: node -e "const env = { ...process.env }; delete env.npm_config_allow_scripts; const { execSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('npm audit', { cwd: './backend', env, stdio: 'inherit' }); execSync('npm audit', { cwd: './frontend', env, stdio: 'inherit' });"
